method: Preserve the approved rc.1 manifest, copy it into a separate rc.2 root, overlay only bounded Figma, Product UI and certification inputs, regenerate a complete content manifest, rebuild in separate temporary roots and run package-local verifiers with an isolated Python environment.
requirements: No package runtime dependency may leave the package or call the network.
Every non-manifest byte must have a size and SHA-256 row.
Two independent temporary builds must match the repository output byte-for-byte.
The Product UI fixture and Figma mirror must preserve their nonproduction and noncanonical boundaries.
Publication, deployment and consumer integration remain outside the package.
knownGaps: The real consumer install, update and rollback proof is deliberately deferred to PORT-04.
